name: @core/3d
summary: 3D for motion design: imported models (GLB/FBX/OBJ), studio lighting, sand & particle effects, product spins, exploded views.
guide:
3D without a 3D tool. Scenes: three:model-hero {model, title, hdr, look, animation}, three:model-turntable {model, turns}, three:model-exploded {model, gap}, three:character-intro {model, animation}, three:sand-disintegrate {model, count, wind, floor}, three:sand-assemble {model, count}, three:particle-morph {from, to}, three:product-spin {image, device}, three:exploded {items}, three:depth-cards {items}, three:hero-object {shape, material}.
Models: mf_asset_put a .glb/.gltf/.fbx/.obj (or a .zip with its textures), then mf_model_inspect (size, parts, animations, missing textures). Without "model" the scenes use a sample shape.
Raw layer {"type":"three"}: objects with shape box|roundedBox|sphere|cylinder|cone|torus|knot|plane|capsule|ring|card|device|image|model|icosahedron|octahedron|group, size, position, rotation (degrees), scale, material glass|metal|matte|plastic|emissive|toon|wire or {…}, keys {position|rotation|scale|opacity}, spin, float, explode, children.
model: {"shape":"model","src":"asset:…","fit":2,"center":"center|base","animation":"Walk"|{name,speed,offset},"materials":{"<name>":{color,roughness…}},"parts":{"<node>":{visible,position,rotation,keys,material}},"explodeParts":0.6}.
effect (any object): {"kind":"disintegrate|assemble|vortex|scatter|morph|pile","count":300000,"at":1,"d":2.5,"sweep":[1,0,0],"wind":[1.6,0.5,0],"turbulence":0.6,"gravity":0.4,"grain":0.012,"floor":-1,"render":"points|grains","target":{…} (morph)}.
Look: lights "studio|soft|dramatic|neon"|[…], "environment":0.8|{"src":"asset:<hdr>","rotation","background":true}, "toneMapping":"aces|agx|neutral", "contactShadow":true, "ground", "fog", "post":{"bloom","ao","dof":{focus,aperture},"vignette","grain","chromatic"}, "motionBlur":{"samples":8}, "quality":"pathtrace" + "samples":256 (GPU hero shots), "cache":true (render once, reuse).
Camera {fov, position, target, keys, orbit {speed,radius,height}, dolly {from,to}}. Previews are draft (fewer particles, no AO/DOF/blur): mf_preview {"final":true} for the real look.
